review_evidence: README identifies the project as Lean SDL3 bindings and points to lean-sdl-test as the example consumer.

SDL.lean defines SDL constants, opaque native handle types, extern IO calls, and thin convenience wrappers; TestApp.lean is an executable graphics/audio demonstration; lakefile.lean clones/builds SDL C libraries and configures native linking.
